title: Silver Lakes Golf & Country Club

services.name: 9 Holes
services.desc: When booking a tee time, sign in as a Member if you already have a Chronogolf profile. If you’re new, select Visitor and create a profile to complete your booking. You’ll be asked to enter your name, phone number, email address, and credit card. Your card is only used to hold the tee time. You will not be charged unless you cancel late (within 24 hours) or do not show up. Once your profile is created, your information auto-fills for faster future bookings. For mobile users, download the free Chronogolf by Lightspeed app for quick, secure bookings. Silver Lakes does not sell or share your personal information. Select the number of players and choose your preferred tee time. Daily-fee tee

services.name: Golf Lessons & Clinics
services.desc: With over 14 years of experience in the golf industry, Kevin Buck is a PGA of Canada professional who specializes in short game development and precision off the tee. Kevin’s teaching philosophy focuses on helping players build consistency, confidence, and control in all areas of their game. Throughout his career, Kevin has worked with golfers of all skill levels at some of Ontario’s top facilities. His personalized, detail-oriented coaching style ensures every student gets the guidance they need to improve and enjoy the game
